name: Get Forward Vector
description: Returns a normalized direction vector along the actor's local X axis (forward), expressed in world space. Companion nodes Get Right Vector and Get Up Vector return the local Y and Z axes respectively.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.description: The actor whose forward direction to read. Often hidden when called from self. Connect any actor reference.

outputs.name: Return Value
outputs.description: Unit-length world-space vector pointing along the actor's local X axis (forward). Multiply by a distance to get a forward offset.
